#Mesh block level exploration

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

session <- getDefaultReactiveDomain()

mb_code_reactive <- reactive({
  query <- parseQueryString(session$clientData$url_search)
  query$mb_code
})

observe({
  mb <- mb_code_reactive()
  if (!is.null(mb)) {
    print(paste("Mesh block code:", mb))
  }
})

```

## Current Mesh Block

```{r}
textOutput("mb_display")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$mb_display <- renderText({
  mb <- mb_code_reactive()
  if (is.null(mb)) {
    "No mesh block specified. Add ?mb_code=YOUR_CODE to the URL"
  } else {
    paste("Displaying data for mesh block:", mb)
  }
})
```
